verification.evidenceBoundary: Each exact vector is derived from the same authenticated recipe and concrete family-dispatch plan as the production relocation. It fixes the production C ABI symbol, family-local adapter id, ordered native ABI, result contract, and emitted JSI module where one exists. Family runtime tests execute the C ABI vectors; JSI is applicable only to families that emit a production JSI module. Provider-boundary families remain excluded until their policy providers exist.
